direction: AD APPROACH — QUESTION HOOK: Open with one short, natural question tied to the product's visible design or a plausible use case. Answer it visually by showing the product and only verified details; finish with a clear, low-pressure CTA to view the product details or available options. Do not invent a problem or benefit.

AD APPROACH — PRODUCT REVEAL: Open on a tight but recognizable view, then reveal the complete unchanged product within the opening beat. Build interest through camera movement and reference-visible details, then close with a concise CTA to explore it.

AD APPROACH — QUICK DEMONSTRATION: Open with the product ready for one simple, physically plausible action it genuinely supports. Show the action clearly, then close with a CTA to check product details. Never invent functions or hidden features.

AD APPROACH — RELATABLE MOMENT: Open with a believable everyday situation relevant to this product. Show the product naturally in that context without promising an unverified result, then finish with a conversational invitation to view the product.

AD APPROACH — PREMIUM EDITORIAL: Open with a refined hero composition, deliberate lighting and a restrained camera move. Use purposeful close-ups of genuine visible details, then end with an understated, elegant CTA. Avoid unsupported luxury claims.

AD APPROACH — LIVELY AFFILIATE: Open with an energetic, conversational Malaysian promoter hook. Keep the product clearly visible and mention only verified details; finish with a direct shopping CTA such as 'Semak produk ini sekarang'. Never invent prices, discounts, stock limits, popularity or false urgency.
